title: Score Candidate Action Trajectories
summary: A candidate plan earns predicted rewards until its first terminal transition.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Latents and normalized commands are dimensionless. Rewards and decoded critic values share the declared dimensionless score scale; inverse temperature has reciprocal score units.

physical_contract.axes: Batch, horizon, action, latent-group, critic and bin dimensions are defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each horizon index is one fixed caller-declared control interval. Termination occurs after the current transition reward. No implicit frame conversion or simulator execution.
physical_contract.batching: Batch, horizon, action, latent-group, critic and bin dimensions are defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Bounded component informed by TD-MPC2 and the pinned official implementation. Affine dynamics and deterministic supplied critic/candidate inputs are declared teaching simplifications, not a trained world model or complete MPC controller.
